answer: Behavioral Cluster Auditing. After rewards are paid, sample transaction graphs and flag new identities whose spending patterns align with known clusters. Enforcement is retroactive: flagged accounts lose accrued balances and future access. An attacker must farm each identity across many epochs to look organic—an onyx-like cost in time and capital per fake account. Correlation across a trellis of interaction edges exposes coordination; a reef of dormant accounts fails when sampled. Cost scales with realism, not count.
